rule: highest pooled leave-one-app-out endpoint-param macro-F1 over all 6 training groups; hyperparameters and threshold then chosen by inner LOAO over all 6 groups
note: LR is also best on third-party apps; RF fails NodeGoat XSS (0.0) in LOAO. LR and LightGBM often chose the top of the threshold grid (0.9); the grid was not widened after seeing outer results.
